# Simple cap purple

Internal ID: HelmetHat10 | Type: Head | Source: Hildir | Buy: 150, Coins | Armor: 1 | Base Item Stamina Usage: -15%

# Introduction

Simple cap purple is an armor piece which can be purchased from Hildir for 150 Coins.

## Notes

• Wearing this armor decreases stamina usage while using the Hammer, the Hoe, the Cultivator, and the Serving tray by 15%.

Categorias: Armor, Head
